Liam (CEO): Quick all-hands alert 4:30 PT on Tuesday in Main. Plan ~30m. Drop one question by Monday EOD.

Priya (VP Product): Agenda: 1) Quick company snapshot (Liam) 2) Launch callouts for region fallback and canary cadence (Priya/Marco) 3) Policy update: default dev-log retention + prompt redaction (Nora/Elena/Anya) 4) Incident recap and TL;DR 5) Q&A (chat first).

Nora (CTO): Policy teaser: hosted dev logs default to 90 days; prompt redaction will be enabled for new projects by default starting May 1. Dedicated customers can opt for custom retention. Full RFC on slide 6.

Elena (SRE): Incident teaser: last week a routing mismatch during a scheduled canary caused a short spike in 5xx in one AZ (~10m). No customer data exposed; circuit-breakers and region failover limited impact. Postmortem in #postmortems.

Anya (Legal): Small policy note: Legal signed off on the retention change and the customer-facing wording. We'll publish a short FAQ post-meeting.

Priya (VP Product): Preflight asks: (1) Add one question by Mon EOD. (2) If you want a 3-min demo, reply with "demo" + 1-line blurb and upload 2 slides to the folder by Mon 11pm PT. Link: https://redwood.internal/allhands/may-small

ops-bot: Reminder: question deadline Mon EOD.

(After meeting)

ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/allhands-2734501110-2027-05-04.mp4 | Slides: https://redwood.internal/allhands/may-small-final.pdf

Liam (CEO): Thanks all. Highlights: hiring focus on infra, region-fallback rollout next week, policy defaults set, incident fixes deployed.

Priya (VP Product): Action items recap: Eng leads post rollout windows in #eng-releases by Fri; Security publish FAQ by Thu; SRE close postmortem tickets and add alert for mapping divergence.

Elena (SRE): Customer blurb approved: "A brief service disruption occurred during an internal canary in one AZ; no customer data was exposed. We restored service and added safeguards."

Nora (CTO): If your question wasn't answered live, DM Priya or me and we'll follow up on the record. Thanks everyone. :tada:
